interpretation: Header schema compatibility only; actual values, alias-value equality, full SHA and strict load remain unverified.
permitted_actions: Implement/synthetic-test bounded transport and header/schema validation; freeze source before network; execute exact two logical range reads once with allowed redirects, no retries/fallback/host expansion.
sanitization: No signed Location/query or raw transport exception strings in logs. Redirect/error bodies can include signed URLs: retain only their byte counts/hash and sanitized status, not raw bodies. Header JSON and 8-byte prefix are retained.
scope: Pinned native checkpoint safetensors prefix/header only; no tensor values/fullweight/model calls
